scripts.dev:backend: docker compose up --build user-service group-service stats-service ocr-service notification-service wallet-service
scripts.dev:backend:micro: docker compose up --build user-service group-service stats-service ocr-service notification-service wallet-service
scripts.dev:backend:manual: concurrently -n "AUTH,GRP,STAT,OCR,NOT" -c "magenta,blue,cyan,green,yellow" "uvicorn main:app --app-dir apps/api-backend --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8001 --reload" "uvicorn main_groups:app --app-dir apps/api-backend --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8002 --reload" "uvicorn main_stats:app --app-dir apps/api-backend --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8003 --reload" "uvicorn main_ocr:app --app-dir apps/api-backend --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8004 --reload" "uvicorn main_notification:app --app-dir apps/api-backend --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8005 --reload"
scripts.dev:mobile: cd apps/mobile-app && EXPO_ROUTER_APP_ROOT=./app npx expo start -c --lan
scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:web" "npm run dev:pwa"
scripts.setup: npm install --legacy-peer-deps && cd apps/mobile-app && npx expo install --fix
scripts.clean: rimraf node_modules apps/web-app/node_modules apps/mobile-app/node_modules apps/api-backend/node_modules packages/domain/node_modules packages/ui/node_modules package-lock.json && npm run setup
scripts.nuke: docker compose down -v --remove-orphans && npm run clean && npm run dev:backend
